content.text: Photo of a power distribution box in a telecom equipment room. Count every breaker module you can see, even when its rating is unreadable (paper labels are blurred on purpose; that is expected). Give each one a position from left to right per row, and set rating_a to null when you cannot read it. Reply with only JSON: {"boxes": [{"breakers": [{"position": number, "kind": "MCB|MCCB|RCD|isolator|unknown", "poles": number|null, "rating_a": number|null, "curve": "B|C|D|null", "dc": true|false|null, "looks_free": true|false|null}]}], "free_breakers": number|null, "readable": "all|some|none", "notes": "one sentence"}. Use null when you cannot read it.
